analysis.title: Walmart Inc: Straight down the fairway
key_insights: BofA reiterates Buy on WMT with price objective raised to $141 from $139. Stock price is $126.04. The PO is based on 44x F28E adjusted EPS.
WMT continues to gain share across categories and income cohorts, led by higher-income households. Management characterized the consumer as stable and resilient.
BofA expects Health & Wellness pricing to be a ~125-150 bp headwind to U.S. comps next year, but expects strong underlying momentum in grocery and general merchandise to continue.
Grocery inflation rose 1.4% this quarter. BofA expects it to reach the mid-2% range over 2027 if oil and commodity costs stay elevated.
Rollbacks ended 3Q at ~7,700, down from >11,000 in 2Q and above the historical ~5,000-5,500 range. This helped drive some of WMT's strongest food share gains in three years.
Walmart+ membership grew double digits in the first few weeks after the Sam's Club Plus bundle launch. Bundled members increased online Walmart spending by more than 80% versus pre-launch.

U.S. advertising grew 37%, with added opportunity from VIZIO's expanding installed base and the recent integration of Vibe. VIZIO OS TVs were the #1-selling TVs in the U.S., with unit volume up nearly 150% y/y.
Marketplace grew 49%. WMT is beginning to forward-deploy marketplace inventory into stores and clubs so sellers can use its express-delivery infrastructure.

BofA raised F27E/F28E EPS by $0.02/$0.05 to $2.89/$3.20 to reflect the 3Q beat and a slightly higher margin forecast. F28E assumes net sales growth of 4.8% (vs 5.6% this year) and operating income growth of 8.3% (vs 8.2% this year).
BofA's F28E EPS of $3.20 matches Visible Alpha consensus ($3.20) and sits below Bloomberg consensus ($3.23). F27E EPS of $2.89 matches Bloomberg ($2.89) and is slightly above Visible Alpha ($2.88).

market_movers.rationale: Share gains across categories and income cohorts, higher-margin advertising and marketplace growth, and a 3Q beat support a PO raise to $141 from $139 on 44x F28E EPS.

earnings_insights: WMT 3Q beat BofA's expectations. BofA raised F27E EPS to $2.89 (from $2.87) and F28E EPS to $3.20 (from $3.15). These are BofA estimates, not reported figures.
BofA's F27E EPS $2.89 vs Bloomberg consensus $2.89 and Visible Alpha consensus $2.88. F28E EPS $3.20 vs Bloomberg consensus $3.23 and Visible Alpha consensus $3.20.
Quarterly EPS table: fiscal 2027 Q1 $0.66A, Q2 $0.81A, Q3 $0.65A reported, Q4 $0.77E (BofA estimate). Fiscal 2026 quarters were $0.61A, $0.68A, $0.62A, $0.74A.
F28E base case assumes net sales growth of 4.8% and operating income growth of 8.3%, versus 5.6% and 8.2% this year.
BofA estimates a ~125-150 bp Health & Wellness headwind to U.S. comps next year.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Modest food inflation supported by rollbacks and share gains.

macro_indicators.reading: mid-2% range over the course of 2027
macro_indicators.interpretation: BofA expects inflation to pick up if oil and commodity costs remain elevated. Slowing food inflation or deflation is a stated downside risk to the PO.

risk_factors: WMT's longer-term ability to keep gaining incremental market share given its size.
Competitive pressures at Sam's Club and/or Walmart International.
